title: John Brown University (JBU)
summary: John Brown University (JBU) is a university in Siloam Springs. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with JBU.

sections.heading: What JBU is known for
paragraphs: John Brown University (JBU) is a private nonprofit institution known for its diverse academic offerings and moderate admission selectivity, with an admission rate of approximately 76.14%. The university enrolls around 1,471 undergraduate students, reflecting a mid-sized campus community. JBU is particularly recognized for its strong emphasis on business education, which constitutes nearly 24.78% of its academic programs. Additionally, health-related programs represent about 6.27% of the university's offerings, highlighting a commitment to preparing students for careers in healthcare fields. These program distributions illustrate JBU's focus on practical and career-oriented disciplines within a private nonprofit educational framework.

sections.heading: How to read JBU tuition
paragraphs: John Brown University (JBU) charges a tuition fee of $31,756 for both in-state and out-of-state students. This uniform tuition rate applies regardless of residency status, simplifying the cost structure for prospective students. The total cost of attendance, which includes tuition along with additional expenses such as fees, room, board, and other related costs, amounts to $44,710. Understanding these figures helps students and families plan for the financial commitment associated with attending JBU.

sections.heading: Financial aid
paragraphs: John Brown University (JBU) offers financial aid to assist students in managing the cost of attendance. Prospective students can use JBU's net price calculator available on their official website to estimate personalized costs and aid eligibility.
